main_result: For an ORIGINAL-coordinate embedding P and baseline M=A_*P with s_m(M)=g>0, an arbitrary symmetric signed packet G with carrier-action coherence c=||Pi_Ran(M) Pi_Ran(GP)||<1 obeys s_m((A_*+G)P)>=g sqrt(1-c^2). If additionally rank(RP)<=q and ||TP||<=epsilon, then for k+q<=m, sqrt(lambda_k((A^2)[H,H]))>=g sqrt(1-c^2)-epsilon for A=A_*+G+R+T. Added eigenvalues in G may have arbitrary signs, magnitudes, multiplicities and rank.
sharpness: The sine factor sqrt(1-c^2) is exact already for m=1,n=2 with a symmetric addition. At coherence c=1 exact cancellation is possible, so no positive norm-free fixed-carrier bound can exist without an alignment/resonance statistic.
